verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al juntzanh tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Tato ay mach tz'ak'an sti' yak'an junok anima t'ayin Jehová in tik, palta snib'ej smananel jun anima chi', yowalil syak' stojol, stupu' icha yalan jun lista tik,
icha echlab' sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub': Ha heb' 20 ab'il sk'inal masanto t'a 60 ab'il, tato winak, yowalil tz'ak'ji 50 siklo k'een plata stojolok. Tato ix, 30 siklo plata syak'a'.
Haxo yuj heb' oye' ab'il sk'inal masanto t'a 20, tato winak, 20 siklo k'een plata syak'a'. Tato ix jun, 10 siklo k'een syak'a'.
Haxo yuj heb' unin jun ujal sk'inal masanto t'a oye' ab'il, tato winak, oye' siklo k'een plata syak'a'. Tato ix jun, oxe' siklo k'een syak'a'.
Haxo yuj heb' icham anima ek'xo t'a 60 ab'il, tato winak, 15 siklo k'een plata syak'a', tato ix jun, 10 siklo k'een syak'a'.
Tato ay junok anima yelxo wal meb'a' jun, max yal-laj yak'an icha sb'isul k'een to chekel yaj chi', tz'ik'chajkot t'a yichanh junok winh sakerdote, snaji jantak wal syal yak'ani.
Haxo pax yuj nok' nok' to tz'ak'jitaxon silab'il t'ayin, masanil nok' tz'ak'ji t'ayin chi', chekel tz'ajkan nok'.
Max yal-laj sk'exji nok' yet' junokxo nok', wach'chom wach' nok', ma chuktak wal nok'. Palta tato sk'exji nok', a nok' sk'exul chi', skanxonhej nok' yet' nok' chekeltaxon yaj chi'.
Haxo pax yuj junok nok' nok' manh wach'oktaxon yoch silab'il t'ayin jun, a nok' chi' tz'ik'jikot t'a junok winh sakerdote,

yik wach' snaji jantak stojol nok', hato syala' chajtil yilji nok'. Icha stojol nok' ix naji yuj winh sakerdote chi', ichanhej chi' tz'ajkan stojol nok' yik schonhchaj yuj yochkan stojol nok' yikok in kajnub'.
Tato hanheja' mach ay yik nok' chi' snib'ej smananpaxel nok' jun, yowalil syak' stojol nok' nab'ilxo chi', syak'an jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh stojol nok' chi'.
Tato ay mach syak' spat t'ayin, tato wach' yaji, mato chuktak wal yaji, a junok winh sakerdote snaani jantak wal stojol. Icha chi' tz'ajkan stojol chi' t'a junelnhej.
Palta tato a mach ay yik jun pat chi' snib'ej smananeli, yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol ix najikan chi', ichato chi' syik'anxi spat chi'.

Tato ay junok mach syak' junok makan sluum t'ayin, a stojol lum lum chi' snaji, hato ha' jantak sat tas tz'el t'a sat lu'um. Tato b'alunhe' arroba ixim kebada tz'elta t'a lu'um, 50 siklo plata stojol lu'um.
Tato tz'ak'ji lum lum chi' t'a yol yab'ilal yoch q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre, skanxonhej stojol lum icha ix aj snajikan chi'.

Palta tato ayik toxo ix lajwiek' jun ab'il chi' tz'ak'ji lu'um, a winh sakerdote syal snaani jantak k'een plata syal yak'ji. Tz'ik'jiemta jab'ok stojol lu'um, hato syala' jayeto ab'il yik ol jax junxo ab'il q'uinh chi'.
Tato a junok mach ix yak' slum chi' t'ayin, snib'ej smananpaxeli, yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol nab'ilkani. Ichato chi' syal yik'anxikan sluum chi'.
Tato max smanel lum mach ix ak'an chi', palta to schonhb'at lum t'a junokxo anima, tato icha chi', maxtzak yal smananxiel lu'um.
Ayik skan lum lum chi' t'a libre t'a yab'ilal he chaan q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre, a jun lum chi', wik tz'ajkan lu'um, haxo heb' sakerdote smakb'enankan lu'um.
Tato ay mach syak' sti' yak'an junok lum lum t'ayin to manb'il yuj, manh smakb'enoktaxon yaji,

a junok winh sakerdote snaan stojol yet' jun anima chi' masanto sjax yab'ilal q'uinh yik tz'el tas t'a libre. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' syak' stojol lum jun anima chi', hato ha' jantak ix aj snaji, tz'ochkan k'een tumin chi' wikok.
Haxo yik sjax jun ab'il chi', smeltzajxi lum t'a mach ix chonhan chi', syalelk'ochi haton jun mach aytaxon yik lu'um.
Ha stojol junok tas sna heb' sakerdote stupchaj icha k'een tumin sk'anchaj b'aj ay in kajnub'. 20 geras yalil junjun siklo k'een plata.
Ha sb'ab'el yune' nok' wakax, ma nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa, wiktaxon yaj a in Jehová in tik. Malaj mach syal yak'an juntzanh nok' chi' yofrendaok t'ayin yujto a sb'ab'el yune' nok' wiktaxon yaji.

Tato a sb'ab'el yune' junok nok' to manh wach'ok icha yalan ley, syal smanjixiel nok' yuj mach tz'ak'an chi', hato syal jantak stojol nok' ix naji, syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol chi'. Tato manhok mach ay yik nok' chi' smananeli, hanheja' icha stojol nok' nab'ilxo chi', syal schonhjiel yuj heb' sakerdote.

Yalnhej tas tz'ak'ji t'ayin t'a junelnhej, junok anima, ma junok nok' molb'etzal nok', ma junok lum lum to smakb'entaxon yaj jun mach tz'ak'an chi', ma junokxo tasi, max yal-laj schonhchaji, max yalpax smanjiel yuj mach ix ak'ani. Wikxo yaj t'a junelnhej.
Haxo pax junok anima toxonton ayoch chamel t'a yib'anh, max yal-laj smanjieli. Ha jun anima chi' yowalil tz'ochxonhej chamel chi' t'a yib'anh.
Ha sdiezmoal sat masanil tas tz'awchaj t'a sat lum lum tik, wach'chom sat ixim, ma sat te te', wiktaxon yaji.
Tato ay junok mach snib'ej smananel jun diezmo chi', yowalil syak' jab'okxo más t'a yib'anh icha stojol chi'.
Jun t'a lajlajunhwanh nok' wakax, ma nok' kalnel, ma nok' chiwa, haton nok' chi' skan t'a diezmoal t'ayin tato wach' nok', ma ay spaltail nok'.

Max yal-laj sik'laj nok', ma sk'exchaj nok' yet' junokxo nok' ch'ok yeli. Tato ay mach snib'ej sk'exan nok', a nok' b'ab'el chi' yet' pax nok' tz'ak'ji sk'exulok nok' chi', skanxonhej nok' schawanhil. Max yalpaxlaj smanjiel nok', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha t'a jolom witz Sinaí ix yak' juntzanh cheknab'il tik Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', yik chonhab' Israel yaji.
